sessionId.description: Claude Code session ID passed to init; null when init got none.

pipelineStatus.description: Set by the cleanup/cleanup-pipeline actions to stamp the pipeline terminal (instead of deleting the state file), so state survives for later reads until GC's TTL prunes it.

pipelineCompletedAt.description: Timestamp paired with pipelineStatus, set by the cleanup/cleanup-pipeline actions.

quick.description: True when ship_prepare was called with quick: steps then come from the [ship] quick profile.

steps.description: Resolved step list for this run: CLI steps, else the quick profile, else config, else the built-in default.

rebase.description: Rebase policy for this run (e.g. auto or skip): CLI value, else config (a bool becomes auto/skip), else auto.

openspecChange.description: OpenSpec change for verify-openspec/archive-openspec: the explicit input, else the plan's **Source:** openspec/changes/<name>/ header, else null.

kind.description: "tracked" (has a begin-step/complete-step lifecycle) or "inline" (recorded via the generic "decide" action). Absent on state files written before this scaffold existed — such entries still validate.

severity.description: Review severity of the finding, lowercased by the defer action. info is included: the default reviewThreshold is info, so a default run defers nothing as below-threshold, but a project on low defers exactly its info findings.

reason.description: Why the finding was deferred instead of fixed. Written by defer since the deferred-reason change; absent on entries recorded before it, so not required.

description.description: The deferring agent's own reasoning (detail.description; defaults to title). Written by defer since the harden step started reading it; absent on older entries, so not required.

lastFailedStep.description: Name of the most recent failed step. Set by fail (R-TASK-17).

historyFailureRecorded.description: Set to true by the first ship_state fail of a run, before it appends the failure row to runs.jsonl. true does not prove the row exists: a failed append leaves the flag set. Stops a second fail row for the same run; the final history_record row of the run is separate.

commitBaseHead.description: HEAD sha seen by the first ship_state commit-check call of the run. Later commit-check calls keep it. A clean tree with HEAD equal to it means nothing to commit; a clean tree with HEAD not equal to it means the commit landed.

linkedPlan.description: Plan run linked to this ship run, saved by complete-step (or legacy complete) of execute when the outcome is not a failure. planFile = the execute state planPath, resolved against its worktree and cleaned. startedAt = planIntegrity.skillInvoked, completedAt = planIntegrity.done (absent when the plan run has no valid RFC 3339 done mark). Survives cleanup-pipeline and GC of the plan state.

planExploreSummary.description: Plan explorer summary copied by cleanup-pipeline before it deletes the linked plan run. One entry for each explorer; top holds at most 5 findings. An empty list means the plan run had no explorer files.

planReviewRounds.description: Plan review rounds copied by cleanup-pipeline before it deletes the linked plan run. Same row shape as the plan state reviewRounds (PlanReviewRound in internal/tools/plan.go). Absent when the plan run had no rounds.

found.description: Blocking issues found in the round (the blockingCount of merge_results).

name.description: Lens name. plan_mark review-round checks it at write time.

findings.description: Optional. Absent when the plan skill sent no findings key.

id.description: The merge_results allIssues id. plan_mark review-round checks its format at write time.

issues.description: Structured issue accumulator appended by fail (R-TASK-17). Mirrors deferredFindings above and execute-state.schema.json's issues[].

sideEffects.description: Idempotency journal keyed by step name ("<step>#<n>" for the n-th entry of a name that occurs more than once in steps[], e.g. "commit#2"), recording each step's verified git/PR side effect so a resumed pipeline can skip re-doing work that already landed. Written by ship_verify_side_effect, and by ship_state commit-check (kind sha, ref = the full HEAD sha) when a clean tree has HEAD not equal to commitBaseHead; consulted by begin-step's alreadyDone flag.

sources.description: Per-flag precedence trace (R6): records which tier won for each key in flags ("cli", "config", "config (version.preRelease)", "config (version.preReleasePolicy)", "config (version.preReleasePolicy enforced over cli)", "quick", "plan" (openspecChange read from the plan's **Source:** openspec/changes/<name>/ header), or "default"). Written by ship_prepare alongside flags.

versionCfg.description: Raw [version] config section snapshot as read by ship_prepare at flag-resolution time (config.ReadSection), for diagnosability. Shape mirrors the project's [version] TOML table and is intentionally not enumerated here to avoid drift.

binaryVersion.description: Build metadata of the sdlc binary that produced this state file (version.GetBuildInfo).

healing.description: Self-healing ledger of the ship run, written only by ship_state healing_record while the run is live. Read verbatim into read's reportData.healing and used for reportData.reviewLedger.

reviewTotal.description: The review step's own finding count. A later review-total record replaces it.

fixed.description: Findings fixed and verified by received-review. Deduplicated on (origin, file, line, title).

fixProgress.description: Fix status of each finding that received-review Step 11 takes. Upserted on (origin, file, line, title). A repeat of the stored status changes nothing. A stored final status (fixed, failed, deferred) is kept when the incoming status is queued or fixing, and a deferred status never replaces a failed status. Any other status change replaces the whole record. firstAt keeps its first value; updatedAt is the time of the last status change. At most 200 records. Independent of fixed[].

hardened.description: Harden runs, one per trigger. A done record replaces a started record with the same trigger; a started record with no done record marks an interrupted run.
